high-entropy alloys in three aqueous environments which simulate acidic, marine, and basic environ-
ments at ambient temperature (-25 -C). The potentiodynamic polarisation curves of the
{ \mathsf { C o } } _ { 1 . 5 } { \mathsf { C r F e - } }
\mathsf { N i } _ { 1 . 5 } \mathrm { T i } _ { 0 . 5 } \mathrm { M o } _ { x }
alloys, obtained in aqueous solutions of
\mathrm { H } _ { 2 } \mathrm { S O } _ { 4 }
and NaOH, clearly revealed that the
corrosion resistance of the Mo-free alloy was superior to that of the Mo-containing alloys. On the other

2.1. Test material

with 1.5 mol of Co, Ni, 0.5 mol of Ti, and 1 mol of the other two
alloying elements and between zero and 1 mol of the added Mo.

percent (wt.%). The multiprincipal-element
